propositions: When acceptance criteria no longer match reality due to subsequent code changes, the completion verifier blocks close and no documented legitimate path exists except force-close or ref-pointing to old commits.
Closing against invalidated criteria leaves inaccurate state in the ticket system regardless of whether force-close or --ref to old commits is used.
The correct remediation is to edit the ticket so criteria accurately reflect current reality, re-pass plan review, then close against corrected criteria.
The --ref <landing-commit> flag is a legitimate close path for criteria invalidated by later work, but this is not currently documented in close workflow guidance.
Criteria invalidated by the fix itself or auto-generated unverifiable criteria cannot be solved by --ref selection and require an auditable criterion-disposition mechanism.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check blocks completion of already-executed work when the criteria registry changes, forcing re-review of finished plans.
